title: AeroBlender
description: AeroBlender is a library mod dependent on TerraBlender, for adding biomes in a simple and compatible manner with Aether's biome/terrain system.
body:
![aeroblender_logo](https://aether.wiki.gg/images/thumb/7/7c/Addon_-_Aether_Biomes_API.png/800px-Addon_-_Aether_Biomes_API.png?20230703223036) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aeroblender) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/aeroblender) ![NeoForge](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/supported/neoforge_vector.svg) ![NoFabric](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/unsupported/fabric_vector.svg) [![Discord](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/AsDEG7smfn) [![Github](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/available/github_vector.svg)](https://github.com/RazorDevs/Aeroblender) [![Issues](https://cdn.sqidgeon.uk/cozy/documentation/issues_vector.svg)](https://github.com/RazorDevs/Aeroblender/issues)
--- > **Important Note:** > AeroBlender comes **pre-bundled** with Deep Aether. If you are experiencing compatibility issues or bugs, please verify that you do not have a duplicate version installed. ## ❓ About **AeroBlender** is a library mod based on **TerraBlender**, specifically designed to bring its biome handling capabilities into **The Aether** dimension. * It provides an API that allows developers to add custom biomes in a simple, compatible way with The Aether. * It is the core for many Aether addons, including *Deep Aether* and *The Aether: Redux*. --- ## 📋 Requirements Make sure you have the following dependencies: * [**The Aether**](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether) * [**TerraBlender**](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrablender) --- ## 🚀 Need a Server?
